tools_used: httpx and pypdf for dated Supreme Court filings
helpful: Frozen context supplied an unambiguous high-band, already-CVSG state.
Snapshot filing links permitted narrowly targeted retrieval without opening a live docket.
Both sides' supplemental briefs materially improved interpretation of the favorable government recommendation.
gaps: The government CVSG response and respondents' supplements were linked in the snapshot but absent from provisioned document text.
The default uv cache was read-only; a temporary writable cache was needed.
Web direct-open attempts returned no usable content and pdftotext was unavailable; installed pypdf provided a working alternative.
notes: No live corpus or CourtListener retrieval was necessary. Petition and opposition text were marked truncated in the manifest. Additional PDF text was parsed in memory, without writing extra input files.
